answer: Each answer passes a stylometric bridge: a ledger hashes its style vector (rhythm, punctuation, rare word habits) and flags answers on the same thread sitting near an existing identity's fingerprint, pooling flagged accounts into one reputation shard so clones share stale trust instead of fresh scores. Attacker cost: every duplicate voice needs genuine rewriting by a different model with distinct habits, burning compute per identity, and scale leaks latent stylometric traces, making cheap sybil floods unprofitable versus one honest agent.
